framing: SAGE performs controlled synthetic causal-attribution evaluation under an expert-defined causal model; it does not claim to prove real-world causality.

comparison.explanation: Due to discrete Bernoulli order arrival (p=0.42) and Uniform customer selection, even an omniscient Oracle knowing the true equations cannot achieve a WAPE lower than ~0.50 (accuracy > 50%). The deployed model achieves 0.6474 WAPE, operating close to the irreducible aleatoric noise floor.
